verdicts.reason: A: the headline and subline run the full width with almost no left margin, the Solstice logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck in the top-right corner, and the can is a small afterthought in the middle with a big dead purple area under it, so the brand is effectively lost. B: the product-left, text-right split suits the format and the can keeps real presence, but the subline is jammed against the right edge, 'light all' is an awkward line break, and the logo is tiny and dropped to the bottom, cut off from the headline.
